sources.title: Official SIH 2026 problem statements, entry SIH26262
sources.supports: Problem scope from the earlier successful retrieval; not an independently verified official judging rubric.
sources.limits: Public listing does not establish access to production APIs or permission to issue decisions. Fresh retrieval during evaluator review returned HTTP 403; latest availability was not reconfirmed.

sources.title: AICTE Approval Process Handbook 2024–25 to 2026–27
sources.supports: Established portal and committee process. Chapter 1 clauses 1.8–1.10, printed pages 7–8 (PDF pages 23–24), describe applicable committee selection, online proceedings with exceptional offline mode, and competent-authority decisions.
sources.limits: Not an exhaustive current amendment review or a legal opinion; scope-specific policy activation still needs approval.

sources.title: NIC Udupi: eOffice capabilities
sources.supports: Electronic approvals, exchange, signatures, integration and scoped MIS.
sources.limits: No authenticated deployment inspected; no absence claim about AICTE-specific capabilities.

sources.title: NIC Informatics: Chittoor FPMS
sources.supports: Pendency tracking and centralized administrative dashboards already exist.
sources.limits: Reported benefits were not independently benchmarked in this review.

sources.title: Creatrix Campus accreditation management product
sources.supports: Configurable accreditation workflows, reviewer and committee work, visit planning and reporting.
sources.limits: Not an executed product test, independent performance audit, or proof of exact SIH26262 coverage.

sources.title: vmedulife product catalogue
sources.supports: Academic, accreditation, IQAC and committee tools are established adjacent products.
sources.limits: Not a regulator-wide deployment audit or a verified market-share comparison.

sources.title: Camunda process orchestration
sources.supports: Durable orchestration, analytics and process evolution are established patterns.
sources.limits: Vendor scale/performance claims were not reproduced; not a recommendation to migrate this repository.

sources.title: Camunda 8 process instance migration
sources.supports: Running process versions can be migrated under explicit mappings and constraints.
sources.limits: Does not validate a local migration implementation or justify automatic regulatory rule changes.

sources.title: Google OR-Tools CP-SAT solver
sources.supports: Constraint solving and explicit optimal, feasible, infeasible and unknown statuses.
sources.limits: Does not establish national scheduling gains; prototype uses a separate exhaustive toy model.

sources.title: Temporal workflows and replay
sources.supports: Durable workflows use recorded event histories and deterministic replay.
sources.limits: A framework capability does not prove local recovery tests or exactly-once external delivery.

sources.title: Perron, Didier and Gay (2023): The CP-SAT-LP Solver (Invited Talk)
sources.supports: Constraint solver technical provenance; LIPIcs CP 2023, 3:1–3:2; DOI 10.4230/LIPIcs.CP.2023.3.
sources.limits: Short invited-talk publication; not an AICTE scheduling trial or evidence of local performance improvement.

sources.title: NIST (2023): Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework, AI RMF 1.0
sources.supports: Responsible AI design criteria including oversight roles, reliability, transparency, privacy and harmful bias management.
sources.limits: Voluntary guidance; not Indian statutory authority or evidence that project controls are implemented and effective.

sources.title: Tax, Verenich, La Rosa and Dumas: Predictive Business Process Monitoring with LSTM Neural Networks
sources.supports: Historical process logs as a basis for predictive monitoring; dataset dependence motivates local evaluation.
sources.limits: Does not validate predictions or accuracy on this repository or AICTE records.

local_evidence.key_finding: Existing applications.stage allows only DRAFT/SUBMITTED; new approval lifecycle records are required.
